research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Qvin is researching a menstrual pad collection system and a collection device for diagnostics of vaginal discharge. The menstrual pad collection system focuses on capturing menstrual blood, while the collection device for diagnostics of vaginal discharge describes a method of analyzing vaginal fluid by collecting it in a vaginal fluid collecting system and transporting it for analysis with secure cloud storage of results. Together these efforts target menstrual blood based lab testing and vaginal fluid diagnostics.
